_source: Jumper Barista's bundle, kept beside the project instead of in deploy/manifests.json so upstream's file stays untouched. `python scripts/deploy.py --manifests barista/deploy/manifests.json --allow-incomplete` builds it.
_simulation_only: MuJoCo simulation project. The bundled mode is jumper.barista's contract driven by the five-foot stance policy with the left-front claw carried; it does not contain the spiral pour, which is the reference replay barista/verification/run_m4.py. No real-robot run is implied, and --allow-incomplete leaves out the board's controller and .rknn on purpose.

barista.description: jumper.barista: Jumper standing on five feet with the left-front claw carried (the five-foot stance policy under the barista task contract). Simulation-only; the pour is replayed by barista/verification/run_m4.py.

barista._note: Export first: python scripts/export.py --task jumper.barista --backend native --device cpu --checkpoint tasks/jumper/five_foot/out/example/model_86600.pt --out tasks/jumper/barista/out/m5 --no-video. Exports are gitignored, so this path exists only after that command.
